content:
Zoe: Alright team, very important watercooler initiative: writing dating profiles for our models. Im starting with a template.
Arjun: This is immediately my favorite thread. :heart_eyes:
Mei: Template idea: \n```\nName: Redwood-XX\nAge: parameters-dependent\nLooking for: low-latency pairings, someone who appreciates concise prompts\nHobbies: token streaming, batch optimization, long-context naps\nDealbreakers: hallucinations, incompatible quantization profiles\n\nA fun fact: I once completed a novel in < 2 seconds\n```\nConnor: \"Parameters-dependent\" is a mood. :100:
Lily: Add \"enjoys long walks through the KV cache\" and \"collects warm starts.\"
Zoe: Also must include an example opening line: `Hey, I cached your prefix. Want to see my attention map?`
Arjun: Can we have a \"compatible with\" field for human coworkers? e.g., \"compatible with engineers who provide clear system prompts and snacks.\" :cookie:
Mei: Poll time. Reply with the number of the profile youd swipe right on: \n```\n1) Redwood-13B: concise, reliable, loves negative prompts\n2) Redwood-70B: talkative, opinionated, writes long threads\n3) Tiny-quant: frugal, fast, slightly cryptic\n4) Canary-early: enthusiastic, occasionally TMI\n5) KV-vet: nostalgic, repeats best prefixes\n```\nConnor: 2
Lily: 3
Arjun: 5
Zoe: 1
Mei: 4 :eyes:
SnackBot: Poll recorded: 1:1, 2:1, 3:1, 4:1, 5:1. Snacks incoming to break the tie. :popcorn:
Zoe: This is turning into a tie again. Tiebreaker reaction: :heart: for 1, :fire: for 2, :zap: for 3, :sparkles: for 4, :anchor: for 5.
(2 minutes later)
Zoe: Final: hearts=2, fire=1, zap=0, sparkles=2, anchor=0. 1 and 4 tied.
Arjun: Okay so concise + enthusiastic is the vibe. Ship a sticker that says \"Swiped Right on Low Latency.\"
Mei: Please no more stickers. Unless its a tiny-quant with sunglasses.
Connor: I volunteer to make a mock profile card for demos. Format: avatar, short bio, latency score.
Lily: \"Bio: seeks partner who appreciates well-structured prompts and will not paste 100k tokens unannounced.\"
Zoe: Tagline idea: \"Looking for mutual context and shared prefixes.\"
SnackBot: FYI: leftover banana bread in kitchen. :banana_bread:
Mei: Thread delivered. I feel seen. 10/10 would write a haiku-like profile next time.
Zoe: Next time we do \"LLM wedding registry\". Youre all warned. :wedding:
Arjun: Bless. Random channel bringing culture again.
